summary: ManagedFile::uploadAjaxCallback() puts status messages in the widget's #prefix, which Xss::filterAdmin() filters, so markup in a message is lost (Olivero's SVG icons; in default_admin the Hide button). MR !16777 sends the messages with MessageCommand into a container it adds to the prefix instead.

facts.text: fago kept the message where it was shown before, inside the widget area, for backward compatibility.
kentr asked whether the problem still occurs with the Default Admin theme now that Olivero is removed.
The lab answers yes: without the MR the Hide button is stripped from the error, with it the button is present and works from the keyboard.
A functional JavaScript test was proposed for the MR (FileUploadAjaxMessageTest.php); it is not in the MR yet.

open.text: Is it acceptable that focus stays on the faded-out Hide button after Enter? A person must judge it (FB-002).
Does a real screen reader speak the error twice (role=alert and Drupal.announce)? Only a synthetic check was run (FB-003).
